description_en: Pilāchẽ Taḥdhaṃ Bāhāḥ is located at Pilāche. Three otherbāhāḥscan be accessed from the eastern side of the route to Subāhāḥ, and Pilāchẽ Taḥdhaṃ Bāhāḥ can be found in the courtyard to the east of these three monastic buildings. The Bāhāḥ has 1 floor and is sitauted on a stone plinth that measures 315cm x 315cm. The entrance gate can be found in the western wall, and is protected by serpents (nāga)that have been placed at the middle of the walls. The entrance is also furnished with two windows, one to the south and one to the north. The structure is topped with a two-tiered roof, distinguished by a layer of plastered dentils. Astūpaabove it acts as a finial. In line with the main shrine and to its west, one can find a Dharmadhātu Jinālaya Caitya and a Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala. The courtyard is paved with telia tiles and is surrounded by tall buildings to the south and north. The western wall borders Pilāchẽ Dathu Bāhāḥ (LAL2080).Pilāchẽ Taḥdhaṃ Bāhāḥ is a monastic building that was privately built and owned by Maharjans. As such, it lacks any connection to other monastic buildings in Lalitpur. Being the biggest in Pilāchẽ area, it is called Taḥdhaṃ (meaning "big" in Nevārī). It is also known as Jñānakīrti Vihāra, as it is said that it was built by Jñānavīra Bhāvo. This monastic building currently has no members and it bears no connection to the two other Pilāchẽ Bāhāḥs next door.The main entrance to the monastic building is via a small passage that runs through privately owned Maharjan houses. This monastic building has no main godhouse (kvāḥpāḥ chẽ), but it does contain a small shrine with a statue of an Aksḥobya Buddha in Bhusparsa Mudrā as its main deity. There are neither guardian animals nor atoraṇain front of the main shrine. Twomeshwindows face north and south, and a Caitya has been placed above the first floor as a finial. The Caitya is a standard one, with four Buddha statues facing in each of the four directions, as well asharmikāand 13bhūmī. The main shrine is surrounded bynāgas(snakes).In front of the shrine, a stone inscription (LAL2100-001_I_20190204_01) contains a records of the monastic building's history, as well as the Dharmadhātu Jinālaya Caitya and Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala.The Dharmadhātu Jinālaya Caitya (LAL2100-002) was constructed in NS 1050 (CE1930), six years before the construction of the main god house.
description_ne: यो कुनै विहारको शाखा विहार नभएर महर्जन समुदायको व्यक्तिले बनाएको स्वतन्त्र निजी विहार हो । त्यसैले अरू विहारमा जस्तो यहाँ संघ-सदस्य छैनन् । पिलाछेँ टोलका ज्ञानवीर भावोले निर्माण गरेको विहार हुनाले यसको नाम ज्ञानकीर्ति विहार रहेको हो । पिलाछेँ टोलमा लहरै रहेका तीनवटा विहारमध्ये ठूलो विहार हुनाले यसलाई पिलाछेँ त:धं बाहा: भनिएको हो ।यो विहारभित्र प्रवेश गर्न महर्जन समुदायको घरको छिँडी भएर जानुपर्छ । अरू विहारको जस्तो यहाँ क्वा:पा:छेँ बनाइको छैन, बरू सानो मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरमा विशेष कलाकारिता देखिँदैन । मन्दिरको भुइँतल्लामा भूस्पर्शमुद्रामा रहेका अक्षोभ्य बुद्धलाई विहारकोक्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको प्रवेशद्वारमाथि तोरण राखिएको छैन, ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ सिंह पनि राखिएका छैनन् । मन्दिरको भुइँतल्लाको उत्तर र दक्षिण भित्तामा स-साना आँखीझ्याल राखिएका छन् । मन्दिरमाथि चैत्य बनाइएको छ । अन्य चैत्यमा जस्तै चैत्यको गर्भमा चार दिशामा चार बुद्ध स्थापना गरी हर्मिका र त्रयोदशभुवन बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरलाई चारैतिरबाट नागले बेरेको देखिने गरी बुट्टा बनाइएको छ ।विहार परिसरमा विहार स्थापनाबारे वर्णन गरिएको एउटा शिलापत्र, एउटा धर्मधातु जिनालय चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरिएका छन् । विहारको पश्चिममा पिलाछेँ दथुबहा: (भीमचन्द्र विहार) को पछाडिपट्टिको भाग रहेको छ । अहिले सो भाग पूरै भत्किएको अवस्था छ । दक्षिण र उत्तरमा आवासीय घरहरू रहेका छन् ।यो विहार स्थापना गर्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले नेसं १०५० (सन् 1930) मा चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको थियो । त्यसको ६ वर्षपछि नेसं १०५६ (सन् 1936) मा मात्र विहारको मुख्य देवताक्वा:पा:द्य:स्थापना गरिएको देखिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: A pūjāwith fasting was perfomed together with a pilgrimage to allbāhāḥs, bahisanddharmadhātus.

historical_events.event_name: Consecration of the image of the main deity in the sanctum of the Vihāra
historical_events.event_description: Śākyamuni Buddha's image was constructed inside the courtyard of the Jñānakīrti Vihāra in memory of Jñānavīra Bhāvo's late wives Asala and Guṃchimī (Guṇalakṣmī). A life-giving ritual (prāṇapratiṣthā) was performed for the image withdaśakarmas.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of the Dharmadhātu Jinālaya Caitya
historical_events.event_description: Jñānavīra Bhāvo and his family constructed the Caitya and performed itsahorātrapūjā(worship for one whole day and night).
This Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala was constructed after a pilgrimage (tīrthayatrā). Aprāṇapratiṣṭhā(life-giving ritual) was performed.
